text: {"lessons":["My Stock D trades show that changing course after a sharp move can lock in a loss and invite buying back at a higher price; I’ll require a fresh, written reason before re-entering.","I’ll check how each trade changes my portfolio’s concentration and cash cushion, rather than judging a stock in isolation.","Before trading, I’ll define the conditions that would make me buy, hold, or sell, and review those rules consistently instead of making repeated reactive adjustments."]}
